defs.def: not done, seen, happening, etc. very often 稀少的；稀罕的

ex.s: According to Charlotte Markey, a professor of psychology, food is one of the rare subjects where, as parents, saying less is more.
ex.t: 据心理学教授Charlotte Markey所说，食物是少数几个话题之一，在这些话题上，作为父母，少说比多说更好。

ex.s: Examples of rare animal diseases.
ex.t: 罕见动物疾病的例子。

ex.s: D Because snow rarely melts on frozen ground.
ex.t: D 因为雪在冻土上很少融化。

ex.s: People now rarely have the patience to read.
ex.t: 如今人们很少有阅读的耐心。

ex.s: Human speech contains more than 2,000 different sounds, from the common “m” and “a” to the rare clicks of some southern African languages.
ex.t: 人类语言包含2000多种不同的声音，从常见的"m"和"a"到某些南部非洲语言中罕见的咔嗒音。

ex.s: They moved in with a local family, the Harrisons, and, like them, had little privacy, rare baths, and a blanket of snow on their quilt when they woke up in the morning.
ex.t: 他们搬去和当地一户姓哈里森的人家同住，和他们一样，几乎没有什么隐私，很少洗澡，早上醒来时被子上还覆盖着一层雪。

ex.s: She has chances to see rare animals.
ex.t: 她有机会看到稀有动物。

ex.s: Scientists have bitterly argued about which methods are the best, and, as we all know, bitter arguments rarely get resolved.
ex.t: 科学家们激烈地争论哪些方法最好，而众所周知，激烈的争论很少能解决。

ex.s: While they are rare north of 88°,there is evidence   61   they range all the way across the Arctic, and as far south as James Bay in Canada.
ex.t: 虽然它们在88°以北很少见，但有证据____61__它们分布横贯整个北极，最南到加拿大的詹姆斯湾。

ex.s: They are keen to see rare birds at the destination．
ex.t: D．他们渴望在目的地看到稀有鸟类。

ex.s: Anger is rarely looked upon as a beneficial character trait, and is usually advised to reduce it.
ex.t: 愤怒很少被视为一种有益的性格特质，通常人们会被建议要减少愤怒。

ex.s: As this artwork is rarely on display, people have sometimes queued up to six hours for a chance to see it.
ex.t: 由于这件艺术品很少展出，人们有时会排队长达六小时只为有机会一睹其风采。

ex.s: It is home to over one hundred nature reserves and many rare species of animals and plants.
ex.t: 它是超过一百个自然保护区和许多珍稀动植物物种的家园。

defs.def: existing only in small numbers and therefore valuable or interesting 稀罕的；珍贵的
cooked for only a short time so that the inside is still red 肉

ex.s: “It’s becoming much rarer to zone out and just let the mind wander, but that’s when we think in ways that broaden our minds.
ex.t: “放空自己、任思绪自由漫游的机会越来越少，但那正是我们以开阔思维的方式思考的时候。

ex.s: However, obtaining items that are rare, recently published or in high demand may take longer.
ex.t: 然而，获取稀有、新出版或需求量大的物品可能需要更长时间。

ex.s: The most effective way to go through life is to try to be that rare mixture known as foxy hedgehog.
ex.t: 最有效的生活方式是努力成为那种被称为"狐狸式刺猬"的罕见混合体。

ex.s: They found it hard to answer, she wrote later, because imagining something that isn’t part of real life—and learning how to make it real—is a rare skill.
ex.t: 她后来写道，他们发现很难回答，因为想象不属于真实生活的东西——并学会如何让它成真——是一种罕见的能力。

ex.s: 20     It’s rare to hear someone say, “I wish that speaker had spoken longer.” On the other hand, you probably can’t count the times that you’ve thought, “I’m glad that talk is over.
ex.t: 20     很少听到有人说："我希望那位演讲者能讲得更久。"另一方面，你可能数不清有多少次你想："真高兴那个演讲终于结束了。"它似乎永远没完没了！所以给你的听众一个惊喜吧。

ex.s: Everyone knows that success rarely happens overnight, but perhaps not many know that a lot of highly successful writers have previously faced rejection.
ex.t: 每个人都知道成功很少一蹴而就，但也许很多人不知道，许多非常成功的作家都曾经历过被拒稿。

ex.s: At age 12, Jane was diagnosed with a rare and deadly cancer, and was informed that high-risk surgery was her only chance of getting better.
ex.t: 12岁时，简被诊断出患有一种罕见而致命的癌症，并被告知高风险手术是她好转的唯一机会。

ex.s: It is also one of the rare locations in the world where scientists can observe in real time the ecological and biological processes that occur as the plants and animals develop and evolve.
ex.t: 它也是世界上少见的地点之一，科学家可以在此实时观察动植物发生和发展的生态和生物过程。
